s:
Which statement correctly compares the revenue systems of Sher Shah and Akbar under Todar Mal?
1. Sher Shah assessed revenue at one-third of average produce.
2. Sher Shah classified land into three categories.
3. Akbar-Todar Mal retained the one-third share but used ten-year averages.
4. Akbar-Todar Mal used four land classes: polaj, parauti, chachar and banjar.

x: All four statements are correct. Sher Shah used three land classes and a one-third rate, while Akbar’s system used ten-year averages and four classes while retaining the one-third share.
tq: Compare the systems across both the rate and the classification method.

Consider the following statements:
